high_level_description: The image is a magazine cover featuring a person standing against a white door background. The individual has shoulder-length blonde hair styled in loose waves and is wearing a leopard print jacket with a black belt cinched at the waist. The person's hands are placed on their hips, giving a confident and assertive pose. The magazine title "W" is prominently displayed in large blue letters at the top left corner of the cover. Below the title, the word "OBSESSED" is written in bold white capital letters, followed by the name "SABRINA CARPENTER" in large blue capital letters.
